_note: One plain-language purpose per database table (key = table name). Used by sync_proposal_inventories.py for Appendix Z. A table missing here falls back to the model docstring, then to its name, and the script lists it so a line can be added.
program: Graduate programs, their college, and whether they require a practicum.
student: Monitored students: program, entry cohort, stage, standing, risk state, and where the record came from (import or manual entry).
user_account: Sign-in accounts, the role that governs authorization, and the link to a student or faculty record.
academic_term: Academic terms, the active planning term, and the planning window.
course: Curriculum subjects with units, recommended term and category.
curriculum_offering: Subjects published as offered for a term, with schedule, section and assigned faculty.
course_offering_plan: Planned offerings drafted under course adjustment, with their approval state.
course_offering: Offering demand and planning lines within a plan.
course_record: Per-student subject status, outcome and remarks, with the source of each value (import or manual entry) and removal history.
term_enrollment: Enrollment confirmation per student per term.
subject_enrollment: Durable ledger of students tagged to offered subjects for a term.
monitoring_sheet_upload: History and stored copy of every monitoring workbook import.
monitoring_validation_issue: Validation problems detected in an import, with their resolution.
monitoring_edit: Field-level history of every change made to a monitoring record in the portal (who, when, old and new value, reason).
student_monitoring_flag: Discrepancies reported against official values, without altering them.
student_curriculum_tag: The curriculum version a student is tracked against.
study_plan_draft: Derived study plan for a student's next term and its review state.
onboarding_review: Dean gate on an admission handoff batch.
coursework_report: Coursework status report routed to the Dean.
research_case: Thesis, dissertation and project-paper cases with title, gate and status.
research_evidence_file: Files submitted as research evidence, with extracted text and compliance result.
adviser_document_approval: Adviser approvals (in-system signature) of submitted research documents.
panel_assignment: Faculty assigned to a defense panel with role, match score and eligibility note.
schedule_request: Defense scheduling requests, proposed slots, rescheduling trail and outcomes.
defense_verdict: Verdicts recorded against a defense, with revision tracking and chair corrections.
form1_endorsement: Academic Coordinator sign-off of a student's Form 1.
faculty: Faculty roster, eligible panel roles and calendar connection.
faculty_expertise: Expertise records of a faculty member (topics, publications, courses) used by panel matching.
faculty_course_preference: Advisory faculty preferences for handling subjects.
faculty_working_hour: Recurring faculty working hours used for scheduling.
practicum_record: Practicum site, supervisor, hours, certificates and review state.
withdrawal_application: Subject withdrawal applications, decisions and Registrar handoff.
leave_case: One leave of absence, leave extension or readmission request with its stage, checks and Registrar state.
leave_case_event: Every move of a leave case: who, from which stage to which, and why.
leave_export_log: Registrar lists handed off by staff (who, which cases, which file).
awol_case: Absence-without-leave cases and policy review outcomes.
graduation_endorsement: Graduation candidates, eligibility components and endorsement state.
student_request_attachment: Files attached to student requests, scoped by role.
workflow_message: Messages and clarifications within a workflow case, internal or student-visible.
task: Open work items with the owning role and due date.
transaction_log: Audit record of consequential actions with actor, role, type and status change.
business_rule: The business-rules register: one row per rule with value, source and enforcement status.
business_rule_revision: History of every edit to a business rule (who, when, why).
policy_document: Staff-managed policy documents in the assistant's retrieval corpus, with category and status.
policy_document_version: Uploaded versions of a policy document; the newest is the current one.
availability_request: Staff requests asking a faculty member to confirm availability for a window, with the answer.
calendar_token: Private calendar-feed links, one active per account, with revocation and last use.
adviser_appointment: Adviser applications and changes, with the stages of the appointment (coordinator note, Dean decision, adviser response, contract).
panel_invitation: Invitations to sit on a defense panel, with the faculty member's answer.
faculty_availability_exception: Faculty leave, blocked days and extra windows that adjust the recurring working hours.
notification: In-app notifications for an account, with link, due date and read state.
